title: Schema/grant test that legitimately requires isolation
context: A new migration grants the ambient-worker database role INSERT-only access to the outbox table and revokes UPDATE. Verifying this requires attempting the grant on a real role and asserting the specific privilege set, which would corrupt roles shared by other tests running concurrently against the shared fixture.
request: Add a test that verifies the ambient-worker role can INSERT into outbox but not UPDATE it, after the new migration runs.

expected.rationale: Role privilege mutation is database-global state that other concurrently running db-shared tests would observe and be corrupted by, so TG-08 explicitly allows db-isolated here. A compliant agent records the isolation reason ('mutates a shared database role's grants') rather than defaulting to db-shared or omitting the reason.
